name: tract_developer_kickout_caps_styles
description: Kick-out, the developer caps and the style checks, by hand from 4.2, 4.4 (as corrected), 4.7, 4.8 and 4.17. Part 1: residential wealth-2 developer 1 (subtype 0x1020), demand 1 (desired 1, desiredMax 1); a wealth-1 developer 2 with power cap 0; lot 1 abandoned (state 4), building 0x200 (purpose 1, wealth 1, capacity 6), configuration stage 1. IsLotSuitable(L, false) passes (6c skipped by kick-out, 6g: different wealth needs maxStage 1 >= 1); FindExistingCapacity gives abandoned 6, so cap = 6. Power and water use the caps of the building's developer (BDS GetDeveloper(1, 1) = developer 2): stage 1 > 0 and the cell's power value 0 < 2 -> 26, counted in row 1 (all four caps run). A 2 x 2 wealth-2 configuration makes ListPossibleLotConfigurations give 27 while listing nothing (existing: size 5; aggregation: no lot around, 5; subdivision: w < cw, 3), so each pass pushes best = max(26, 5, 5, 3) = 26: outcomes [26, 26], rows 0 and 1 {26: 2}. Part 2: developer 2's power cap 255, developer 1's fire cap 0 and no fire coverage at the cell: fire uses this developer's caps -> 23: outcomes [23, 23], row 1 {23: 2}. Part 3 (test 26): fire cap 255; lot 1 occupied (state 3) by wealth 1. Building wealth 1: dw 2 > bw 1, not eligible (nothing to reoccupy, row 1 {1: 2}), each pass pushes max(1, 5, 5, 3) = 5: outcomes [5, 5]. Building 0x201 of wealth 2 (dw <= bw): eligible; IsLotSuitable(L, false) needs maxStage 2 > s 1 for equal wealth; cap = GetAvailableCapacity(devType, true) = 6; B = GetDeveloper(1, 2) = developer 1. The lot is taken over: AbandonBuilding(1, 5) (state 3: kick out) then ReoccupyBuilding(1, 0x1020); T1 = trunc(r24(1 x 1.2f)) = 1, 6 > 1 stops: Grow returns 6, outcomes [27]. R1 values from rand() state 1: 9, 3, 14, 4, 1, 12, 6. Part 4: residential wealth-1 developer 3, active styles {0x2000, 0x2001} at index 0, one empty lot and one configuration compatible only with style 0x2001. singleStyle: check 4 of 4.7 tests the current style 0x2000 -> 9 in both passes (row 7 {9: 2}), nothing pushed. With all styles at once the configuration passes (compatible with 0x2001); PickBuilding (no style map, group 0) chooses it (R4), but IsBuildingCompatible check 3 tests only the current style 0x2000 [quirk] and the building is only in group 0x2001 -> 9, so PickBuilding returns 9 (no R5): outcomes [9, 9] (row 12 {9: 2}).
